```{r setup, include=FALSE}
ENIA_ROOT <- "~/ENIA-5120"
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)
library(scales)

ev_df <- read_csv(file.path(ENIA_ROOT, "data", "wa_ev_population.csv")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(county), county != "", !is.na(model_year))

county_choices <- sort(unique(ev_df$county))
type_choices <- sort(unique(ev_df$ev_type))
make_choices <- sort(unique(ev_df$make))
```

## Shiny Story Dashboard

```{r}
ui <- navbarPage(
  "Washington EV Story Dashboard",
  tabPanel(
    "County Snapshot",
    p("Explore how EV adoption shifts across counties, years, and vehicle types."),
    hr(),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        width = 3,
        wellPanel(
          h4("Filters"),
          selectInput("county_pick", "County", choices = county_choices, selected = county_choices[1]),
          sliderInput(
            "year_range",
            "Model year range",
            min = min(ev_df$model_year, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(ev_df$model_year, na.rm = TRUE),
            value = range(ev_df$model_year, na.rm = TRUE)
          ),
          selectInput("ev_type_pick", "EV type", choices = c("All", type_choices), selected = "All")
        )
      ),
      column(
        width = 9,
        wellPanel(
          h4("Headline"),
          textOutput("story_kpi")
        ),
        wellPanel(
          h4("Top Makes"),
          plotOutput("make_plot", height = "420px")
        ),
        wellPanel(
          h4("Model Year Summary"),
          tableOutput("make_table")
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  tabPanel(
    "Manufacturer Trends",
    p("Track how EV registrations change over time for selected manufacturers."),
    hr(),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        width = 3,
        wellPanel(
          h4("Trend Filters"),
          selectizeInput(
            "make_pick",
            "Manufacturers",
            choices = make_choices,
            selected = head(make_choices, 5),
            multiple = TRUE
          )
        )
      ),
      column(
        width = 9,
        wellPanel(
          h4("EV Registrations by Year"),
          plotOutput("manufacturer_trend_plot", height = "480px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  filtered_story <- reactive({
    current_df <- ev_df %>%
      filter(
        county == input$county_pick,
        between(model_year, input$year_range[1], input$year_range[2])
      )

    if (input$ev_type_pick != "All") {
      current_df <- current_df %>% filter(ev_type == input$ev_type_pick)
    }

    current_df
  })

  output$story_kpi <- renderText({
    # write a one-sentence takeaway using filtered_story()
  })

  output$make_plot <- renderPlot({
    # make a plot of the top makes in the filtered data
  })

  output$make_table <- renderTable({
    # summarize the top makes or model years in a table
  })

  manufacturer_trend <- reactive({
    # summarize EV counts by manufacturer and model year
  })

  output$manufacturer_trend_plot <- renderPlot({
    # plot how EV registrations evolve over time by manufacturer
  })
}

story_dashboard <- shinyApp(ui, server)
```
